rows.jp: 動物化する俺。

ghs.en: I animalize.
ghs.assessment: The narrator says he becomes animalistic. 'Animalize' is normally transitive and means to turn something into an animal.

rows.jp: カメラ。

ghs.en: Camera.

rows.jp: 嗚呼、カメラ。

ghs.en: Alas, camera.

rows.jp: どうしてカメラを、持ってこなかったんだ……俺は？
rows.en: Why hadn't I brought a camera...? What was I thinking?

ghs.en: How come a camera you didn't bring with... myself?
ghs.assessment: The narrator asks himself why he did not bring a camera. The English shifts to second person, strands the object, and appends a contradictory reflexive.
ghs.remedy: Why didn't I bring a camera... with me?

highlights.text: How come a camera you didn't bring with... myself?

rows.jp: 苛立ち。怒り。

ghs.en: Irritation. Anger.

rows.jp: 自分に対する怨嗟が、黒い炎となって膨れあがる。
rows.en: My rancor toward myself swelled into a black flame.

ghs.en: The deeply held resentment towards myself becomes a dark wicked flame and swells outwards.

rows.jp: どうして！　今！　この場で！　カメラを持てない！
rows.en: Why! Here! Now! Couldn't I have a camera!

ghs.en: WHY! RIGHT NOW! RIGHT HERE! YOU HAVE NO CAMERA!
ghs.assessment: The narrator angrily asks why he himself does not have a camera here and now. The English directs the statement at a second person.
ghs.remedy: WHY DON'T I HAVE A CAMERA!

rows.jp: モノローグを力強く区切り、猛省の嵐に身を置く。
rows.en: I hammered out each fragment of the monologue, then cast myself into a tempest of remorse.

ghs.en: Vigorously punctuating a monologue, I lay my self whole into the thunderstorm of deep soul-searching.
ghs.assessment: The reflexive is incorrectly split and the verb/preposition construction is non-idiomatic.
ghs.remedy: I throw my whole self into

highlights.text: I lay my self whole into

rows.jp: 霧のハレンチは、それだけでは終わらない。
rows.en: Kiri's indecency did not end there.

ghs.en: And Kiri's shamelessness does not have end with that alone.
ghs.assessment: The English uses 'have end' instead of the required verb phrase 'end' and attaches an unnatural qualifier.

highlights.text: does not have end with that alone
